text:
elaine.sales: Quick check — LargeFin wants to run a sealed-environment POC next week. High-level asks: packaging format, upgrade/patch cadence, offline license activation flow, and any gaps in the security questionnaire. Anyone free to confirm constraints?

matt.se: I can take the runbook. Important constraints: fully detached network, bundle must be cryptographically signed, we provide SBOM, and need an offline license activation mechanism (signed license file or USB token).

jess.secops: From security side we need FIPS-validated crypto choices (or documented mitigations), HSM/KMS support for key storage, and a threat-model + signed-image verification steps. Also indicator: they want evidence of our signing pipeline.

matt.se: Packaging we usually deliver a single release tarball with a detached ed25519 signature and a manifest.json with SHA256 checksums for each artifact. Upgrade options: (1) cumulative monthly bundle, (2) monthly security deltas, (3) emergency hotfix delta. Customer can choose cadence; default is monthly security deltas + quarterly feature bundles.

elaine.sales: Pricing question: do we bill extra for custom signing/packaging or is that included in Dedicated/Private contracts?

tom.legal: Our standard private deployment annex covers signed bundles and SBOM. Custom integration (customer HSM or bespoke signing workflow) is typically PS work and billed. I'll pull the rate card and confirm.

matt.se: Ops notes / install snippet they can run offline:
```bash
# create cluster id (example)
cat /etc/machine-id | sha256sum > cluster.id
# offline install with signed license
./install.sh --offline --license /path/to/license.jwt
# rollback example
./install.sh --rollback --to 1.2.3
```

deploy-bot: package-verify: bundle v20261320.tar.gz - signatures OK, SBOM present, manifest checksums match. :white_check_mark:

jess.secops: Also need confirmation on data-at-rest encryption and key rotation policy in private deploys. Without outbound, how do we prove rotation? Do we support customer-managed rotation via their KMS/HSM?

matt.se: Yes — we support customer-managed keys. Default rotation is every 90 days; we document the rotation steps and can provide scripts for on-prem/KMS integration.

elaine.sales: Rollback question from customer — if a delta patch fails, can we revert?

matt.se: Installer keeps the previous release under /opt/redwood/releases/<version>, rollback is supported via the install script (see snippet).

elaine.sales: Action items: Matt -> drop sealed-environment runbook + sample signed license flow by EOD. Jess -> mark any blocking items from the security questionnaire. Tom -> estimate PS days and any legal terms for offline signing. I will share back to the customer after we have docs.

tom.legal: Quick PS estimate: ~5 days for custom signing integration + 2 days for compliance review; will confirm with SOC team.

matt.se: Aiming to produce runbook, sample manifest, example license.jwt, and a short demo script today. :thumbsup:

elaine.sales: thanks all — looping in LargeFin (cc) once we have the artifacts. :pray:
